0022600207.text: The Indiana Pacers (3-7, 11th in the East, 3rd in the Central and 3.5 games back) visit the Dallas Mavericks (6-4, 10th in the West, 4th in the Southwest and 2 games back) for the Pacers' 11th game of the season, with Indiana 0-5 at home and 3-2 on the road, while Dallas is on a two-game winning streak. Indiana is missing Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain, averaging 21.8 points and 33.0 minutes per game this season), Ben Sheppard (knee) and Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Morez Johnson Jr. (leg), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The Pacers trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 121-105 loss in Indianapolis on October 23, and they lost both meetings in the 2025-26 series, 0-2.
